description: This is a test class for the KeyboardExtensionFactory in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of getting and setting keyboard extensions for top, bottom, and extension rows, as well as retrieving all available extensions.

classes.name: KeyboardExtensionFactoryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the KeyboardExtensionFactory's functionality in managing keyboard extensions.

methods.name: testGetCurrentKeyboardExtensionBottomDefault
methods.description: Tests retrieving the default bottom row keyboard extension and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetCurrentKeyboardExtensionBottomChanged
methods.description: Tests changing the bottom row extension and verifies the updated extension properties.

methods.name: testGetCurrentKeyboardExtensionTopDefault
methods.description: Tests retrieving the default top row keyboard extension and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetCurrentKeyboardExtensionTopChanged
methods.description: Tests changing the top row extension and verifies the updated extension properties.

methods.name: testGetCurrentKeyboardExtensionExtensionDefault
methods.description: Tests retrieving the default extension keyboard extension and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetAllAvailableExtensions
methods.description: Verifies the retrieval of all available extensions for bottom, top, and extension categories.

methods.name: assertBasicListDetails
methods.description: Helper method to verify the list of extensions has the expected size and type.
